scope.objects: finite-dimensional analytic or polynomial block-response germs near a rank-changing locus
scope.regularLocus: points where the eliminated block D is invertible on its support
excluded: smooth flat germs unless their full germs, rather than jets, are retained

fields: germ gamma with gamma(0) in S
limit or pole class of A-B D^-1 B^T along gamma

morphisms.action: D maps to T^T D T and B maps to B T for analytic invertible T
morphisms.invariant: the full correction B D^-1 B^T

morphisms.action: precompose all germs and approach arcs by an invertible parameter germ
morphisms.invariant: existence and equality of ordinary finite limits
morphisms.nonInvariant: Hadamard finite parts of poles without a transported subtraction scheme

morphisms.action: identify arcs only when the retained germ data force the same response
morphisms.invariant: response functor on the resulting quotient groupoid

dispatcher.condition: rank change and the full correction has one finite cluster value
rank change and finite cluster values depend on the approach arc
dispatcher.output: arc-groupoid-valued response; do not descend to one value

dispatcher.condition: the correction is unbounded along at least one admitted arc
dispatcher.output: retain the interior or refuse elimination

dispatcher.condition: a normal coordinate and subtraction prescription are explicit decorations
dispatcher.output: scheme-relative renormalized response with the scheme retained in its type

measureInterpretation.statement: When each response is Herglotz, it may separately carry its positive operator-valued representing measure. Measure-valued representation preserves passivity and residues but does not identify inequivalent approach arcs.
measureInterpretation.forbiddenInference: positivity alone implies descent from the arc groupoid to the singular point

descentCriterion: A scalar/matrix response at a singular point exists exactly when the response functor is constant on all admitted approach objects and finite there.
